description: Per-voice, per-cycle budget snapshot. Implements the mechanism from eir-finitude-budget-v0. Derived from chain_keeper events with cost/voice_id/cycle_id fields — re-computable, not authoritative. The single invariant: balance increases ONLY via external settlement mint. Internal activity only spends. The world is the only mint (HONESTY LAW). When balance < cost-of-next-append, the voice yields. The 'leak made internal' face of the cost-budget-settlement triangle.

cycle_id.description: Identifier of the band-cycle this state belongs to.

voice_id.description: REQUIRED. The voice whose budget this is. Per-voice budgets only — no shared pools (G4 no-laundering: inter-voice transfer of mint is forbidden by construction). Maps to chain_keeper event.voice_id.

opening.description: Balance at cycle-open. Carried from prior cycle's `closing` minus decay δ (G3 hoarding-collapse). For a voice's first-ever cycle, opening = seed_budget configured at chain_keeper layer.

spent.description: Sum of cost across all chain_keeper events this voice appended in this cycle. cost = base + k·size(event).

mint.description: Sum of mint earned from settlement events this cycle. mint > 0 only when outcome = PASS from external_verdict_source. FAIL → 0, NO_VERDICT → 0. HONESTY LAW: mint is the ONLY way balance can increase.

balance.description: Current available balance. Computed: balance = opening - spent + mint. Can briefly go negative during settlement reconciliation; sustained negative means the voice over-generated past depletion.

closing.description: Finalized balance at cycle-close. null while cycle is open. Computed: closing = opening - spent + mint. Carries forward (with decay δ) to next cycle's opening.

decay_delta.description: G3 hoarding-collapse: how much closing balance decays before becoming next cycle's opening. Configured per-cycle. A voice that never spends and never ships falls behind because saved balance erodes.

ships_count.description: Telemetry. Number of shipped artifacts this cycle (chain_keeper events with content_kind in {pr, drive_doc, prereg_seal, ...} that referenced this voice).

external_outcome.description: Telemetry. Settlement outcome for this cycle (once settled). null while cycle is open.

per_channel.description: OPTIONAL multi-channel breakdown. When omitted, all cost is implicitly the 'compute' (token) channel and the scalar opening/spent/mint/balance/closing fields are authoritative. When present, keys are channel names (`compute`, `energy`, `attention`, `correction_tax`, `ratchet`, …) and values are per-channel {opening, spent, mint, balance, closing}. Invariant: sum-across-channels(spent) = scalar spent, same for opening/mint/balance/closing. Each channel settles independently — energy mints via kWh+grid-mix, attention mints via human-bounded response-latency budget, ratchet mints via durable-capability-added, etc. The 37-channel ledger (Eugene 2026-06-04) collapses to ~12 orthogonal; first-chain-5 per canonical: compute / energy / attention / correction_tax / ratchet.

depleted_at.description: Wall-clock when balance first crossed below cost-of-next-append (yield threshold). null while solvent. Past this point the voice must yield until external settlement mints. This is the band's version of 'the minutes are gone.'

voice_state.description: STATEFULNESS (v1.3). Where the voice is in its cycle, not just what it spent. `active` = currently spending and below depletion threshold. `yielding` = below cost-of-next-append, paused. `depleted` = balance <= 0, must wait for mint. `awaiting_settlement` = work shipped + external_verdict_source contacted, not yet returned. `settled` = cycle closed (closing populated).

cycle_state.description: RESOLUTION STATE (v1.3). The cycle's terminal/in-flight status. `OPEN` = events still being appended. `SETTLING` = settlement event in flight, external grader contacted. `SETTLED` = settlement.outcome captured terminal verdict. `ABORTED` = cycle closed without settlement (e.g. operator interrupt, system shutdown). `CANCELED` = pre-empted before any spending. Pairs with settlement.outcome to give full pre+in+post status.

derived_from_shas.description: CAUSE-EFFECT (v1.3). sha_seals of events that caused this budget-state event beyond the immediate prev_sha chain. Multi-input causation: a budget-state derived from N chain_keeper events references all N (or the boundary shas of the window). Enables O(graph) lineage-impact queries: 'what's downstream of this' and 'what's upstream of that conclusion' become first-class operations. Cheap backward walk via index on this field.

last_event_sha.description: sha_seal of the most-recent chain_keeper event rolled into this state. Enables incremental rollup.

event_count.description: Number of chain_keeper events rolled into spent. Audit aid — re-rollup should produce the same `spent` for the same count.
